mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT att.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY att.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID ORDER BY att.ASN_SBM_ATT_REG_DATE DESC ) AS rn FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_ATTACHMENT att WHERE att.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' ) WHERE rn = 1
mapper.select: SELECT s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, a.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, pm.MEMBER_NAME AS professor, a.LEC_ASN_TITLE AS lecAsnTitle, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(a.LEC_ASN_CONTENT, 4000, 1) AS lecAsnContent, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS lecAsnDueDate, CASE WHEN a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE < SYSTIMESTAMP OR a.LEC_ASN_VAL_STATUS IN ('CLS', 'NOP') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdueFlag, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS submissionId, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS AS lecAsnSbmStatus, TO_CHAR(sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_REG_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS lecAsnSbmRegDate, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_MEMO AS lecAsnSbmMemo, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_EXT_TYPE AS fileExt, ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE AS asnSbmEvlScore, ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_FEEDBACK AS asnSbmEvlFeedback FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT a ON a.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE pp ON pp.LMS_PRF_ID = l.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER pm ON pm.MEMBER_ID = pp.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb ON sb.LEC_ASN_ID = a.LEC_ASN_ID AND sb.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID LEFT JOIN ( ) att ON att.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID LEFT JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev ON ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) >= TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) ORDER BY s.SEM_YEAR DESC, s.SEM_ID DESC, a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE DESC, a.LEC_ASN_ID DESC
mapper.sql: FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT a ON a.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE pp ON pp.LMS_PRF_ID = l.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER pm ON pm.MEMBER_ID = pp.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb ON sb.LEC_ASN_ID = a.LEC_ASN_ID AND sb.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) >= TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) AND a.LEC_ASN_VAL_STATUS IN ('AVL', 'MOD', 'LAT') AND (a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE >= SYSTIMESTAMP OR a.LEC_ASN_VAL_STATUS = 'LAT') AND (sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID IS NULL OR sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS = 'NSB')
mapper.select:
SELECT s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, l.LEC_ID AS lecId, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, a.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, pm.MEMBER_NAME AS professor, l.LMS_PRF_ID AS professorLmsPrfId, a.LEC_ASN_TITLE AS lecAsnTitle, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(a.LEC_ASN_CONTENT, 4000, 1) AS lecAsnContent, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ASN_REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS lecAsnRegDate, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS dueLabel, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS dueIso, a.LEC_ASN_VAL_STATUS AS lecAsnValStatus
ORDER BY a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE, a.LEC_ASN_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear
ORDER BY semYear DESC

SELECT a.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, a.LEC_ASN_VAL_STATUS AS lecAsnValStatus, CASE WHEN a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE < SYSTIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdueFlag, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS submissionId, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS AS lecAsnSbmStatus FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT a ON a.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID LEFT JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb ON sb.LEC_ASN_ID = a.LEC_ASN_ID AND sb.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' AND a.LEC_ASN_ID = #{assignmentId}

SELECT a.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, a.LEC_ASN_VAL_STATUS AS lecAsnValStatus, CASE WHEN a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE < SYSTIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdueFlag, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS submissionId, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS AS lecAsnSbmStatus FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT a ON a.LEC_ASN_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_ID JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = a.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = sb.LMS_PRF_ID WHERE sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = #{submissionId} AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP'

SELECT att.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS submissionId, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_EXT_TYPE AS contentType, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_TRN_FIL_NAME AS trnFileName, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_ORG_URL AS orgUrl FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_ATTACHMENT att WHERE att.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = #{submissionId} AND att.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' ORDER BY att.ASN_SBM_ATT_REG_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION SET LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS = 'NSB', LEC_ASN_SBM_MEMO = NULL WHERE LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = #{submissionId} AND LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS = 'SBM'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_ATTACHMENT ( ASN_SBM_ATT_ID, LEC_ASN_SBM_ID, ASN_SBM_ATT_REG_DATE, ASN_SBM_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME, ASN_SBM_ATT_TRN_FIL_NAME, ASN_SBM_ATT_ORG_URL, ASN_SBM_ATT_FIL_SIZE, ASN_SBM_ATT_EXT_TYPE, ATT_VAL_STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_ATTACHMENT.NEXTVAL, #{submissionId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{orgFileName}, #{trnFileName}, #{orgUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{extType}, 'ACT' )
mapper.update: UPDATE ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_ATTACHMENT SET ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'DEL' WHERE LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = #{submissionId} AND ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT'
